how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-valley-of-trials-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:787:obj:0: Report to Gornek in the Den.
rows.quest:787:details:0: Throm'ka, ⟦1⟧. I am Eitrigg, charged by Thrall to oversee the training of recruits.
rows.quest:787:details:1: BThe ⟦E1⟧ has changed from what it once was. There was a time where I left the ⟦E1⟧, disillusioned by the growing influence of the power-hungry pawns of the ⟦E2⟧. During my exile, I was taken prisoner by a group of humans, but was rescued by the Warchief. Hearing his vision of the ⟦E1⟧ free of demonic influence, guided by the shamans, I returned.
rows.quest:787:details:2: BGornek will have further instructions for you.
rows.quest:787:completion:0: Another one of Eitrigg's recruits, hm?
rows.quest:787:completion:1: BA sorry state of affairs we find ourselves in if this is the best the ⟦E1⟧ can produce. No matter. By the time we think you're ready to leave the Valley, you'll be a proud warrior of the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:788:obj:0: Kill 10 Mottled Boars then return to Gornek at the Den.
rows.quest:788:details:0: The first order of business will be to put a little strength in your backbone. I could send you out to the ⟦E3⟧ to hunt kodo, but well, in all honesty, you're more useful to us alive than dead.
rows.quest:788:details:1: BI believe you would find a good match with the mottled boars you'll find to the north of here.
rows.quest:788:completion:0: Hmmm, not bad, ⟦2⟧. But don't let it get to your head...you'll fight tougher than boars in your career.
rows.quest:788:completion:1: BNonetheless, you've proven yourself well, and your next trial will be against a considerably more dangerous opponent, so you'll need some extra protection.
rows.quest:789:obj:0: Get 10 Scorpid Worker Tails for Gornek in the Den.
rows.quest:789:details:0: Powerful warrior and awkward novice alike have fallen to the venomous sting of the scorpid. You will find large numbers of scorpids northwest of here. Bring me ten of their tails as proof of your prowess in battle.
rows.quest:789:details:1: BThe antidote for their sting is actually made from venom extracted from their stingers. We keep large quantities of antidote for scorpid venom on hand to heal young bloods just like you...
rows.quest:789:details:2: BBut I'm sure you won't be needing any of that, will you?
rows.quest:789:completion:0: There is an important lesson that you must take away from fighting scorpids. The smallest or largest of opponents can still send you to your doom. In fierce combat, any number of things can prove your downfall.
rows.quest:789:completion:1: BI have no more to teach you, ⟦3⟧. You have done well, and I will watch your progress with interest.
rows.quest:790:obj:0: Kill Sarkoth and bring his claw back to Hana'zua.
rows.quest:790:details:0: ⟦4⟧! I thought I would die out here with none to know of it. While I was hunting the scorpids of the Valley, I came across a particularly vicious-looking one. Hurling myself at it, I managed to inflict a massive blow to its claw before it closed around my leg.
rows.quest:790:details:1: BI wasn't ready for its stinger though, and it sliced down and into my chest, cutting into my flesh and letting my blood. Please, you must kill the scorpid for me! My honor must be upheld! I fought it up on the plateau to the south.
rows.quest:790:completion:0: My blow was not enough to kill him, but looking at the damage I inflicted gives me some small measure of pride. That small measure will be all I have to sustain myself if I die, and in that light, the short list of my life's accomplishments fills me with anger.
rows.quest:792:obj:1: BReturn to Zureetha Fargaze outside the Den.
rows.quest:792:details:0: I trust the Valley of Trials will teach you much, young ⟦5⟧.
rows.quest:792:details:1: BI was sent to the Valley to guide you, but I have discovered a growing taint here...
rows.quest:792:details:2: BA group that calls itself the Burning Blade has a coven here in the Valley of Trials. They are skulking in a cave to the northeast, and their Vile Familiars have spilled from its mouth to cause havoc.
rows.quest:792:details:3: BAs your first task against the Burning Blade, I bid you, defeat these familiars. Slay many and, if you survive, return to me.
rows.quest:792:completion:1: BAlthough the Vile Familiars were merely pets of the darker powers within the Burning Blade, your success against them foretells greater deeds ahead.
rows.quest:794:obj:0: Bring the Burning Blade Medallion to Zureetha Fargaze, outside The Den.
rows.quest:794:details:0: Through my divinations, I see that an item of power hides deep within the Burning Blade Coven, guarded by beasts and black magic.
rows.quest:794:details:1: BIt is called the Burning Blade Medallion, and your next task is to find it and remove it from the coven.
rows.quest:794:details:2: BBut be wary, for the medallion may be possessed by an agent of the Burning Blade, and if so then the agent's power would be greater than the familiars you have already encountered.
rows.quest:794:details:3: BGo, ⟦7⟧. You will find the coven in a cave, to the north and west.
rows.quest:794:completion:1: BYour efforts within the Burning Blade Coven are key in rooting out this cult in the Valley of Trials. But I fear they have further aims in our land.
rows.quest:794:completion:2: BWe have not seen the end of them.
rows.quest:804:obj:0: Bring the news of Hana'zua's plight to Gornek at the Den.
rows.quest:804:details:0: Seeing the deed you have done for me steels my heart. I cannot fall so easily! I must endure!
rows.quest:804:details:1: BBut it remains that I cannot make the trek back to the Den unassisted. Please, ⟦8⟧, return to the Den and tell Gornek of my situation. Perhaps he can help me.
rows.quest:804:completion:0: From your description of the beast, I believe you must be speaking of Sarkoth! It is no wonder that Hana'zua was overtaken by it. Aid will be dispatched to him immediately, trouble yourself no more with Hana'zua's plight.
rows.quest:804:completion:1: BHowever, I must say, I am most impressed to hear that you brought Sarkoth to death. It is a feat to be proud of, ⟦9⟧. And that you would fight for a stranger's honor, while other tasks occupied your time, your own honor is heightened.
rows.quest:805:obj:0: Speak with Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
rows.quest:805:details:0: Your trials against the Burning Blade are finished... here in the Valley. But I want you to report your findings.
rows.quest:805:details:1: BGo to the troll village of Sen'jin and seek out Master Gadrin. Sen'jin Village is east out of the valley, then right at the fork.
rows.quest:805:details:2: BTell Gadrin of the Burning Blade, and that they have reached the Valley of Trials. Discover from him if they have yet reached Sen'jin.
rows.quest:805:details:3: BGo, ⟦10⟧, and be swift. I fear the evil found in the Burning Blade Coven is but the herald of a larger threat...
rows.quest:805:completion:0: Hm... your report comes at a bad time. The Burning Blade is not seen here in Sen'jin, but their evil has taken seed off the coast, on the Echo Isles.
rows.quest:805:completion:1: BThe orcs are friends of the ⟦E4⟧ Trolls. Honorable friends. We want to help the orcs, but... we need help too.⟦11⟧
rows.quest:4402:obj:0: Bring Galgar 10 Cactus Apples. You remember him saying that they could be found near cactuses.
rows.quest:4402:details:0: It sure gets hot out here in the Valley of Trials.
rows.quest:4402:details:2: BIf only I had some cactus apples, I could make my famous cactus apple surprise! Nothing cools you off faster than a piece of that delicious treat.
rows.quest:4402:details:3: BI'll tell you what, ⟦13⟧. If you bring me 10 cactus apples, I'll make you a few portions of cactus apple surprise to take with you on your adventures. If you're interested, you can find cactus apples growing near the cactus plants around here.
rows.quest:4402:completion:0: Wonderful, ⟦14⟧! As promised, here is your cactus apple surprise plus a little something extra.
rows.quest:4641:obj:0: Speak with Gornek. You recall Kaltunk marking your map with his location and mentioning that Gornek resided in the Den, a building to the west.
rows.quest:4641:details:0: Finally, you are of age, ⟦15⟧... of age to battle in the name of the ⟦E1⟧. To conquer for the glory of the Warchief.
rows.quest:4641:details:4: BNo doubt you wish to find a great dragon or demon and strangle it with your bare hands, but perhaps it would be wise to start on something less... dangerous.
rows.quest:4641:details:6: BReport to Gornek, he should be able to assign a task better suited to a young ⟦18⟧. You will find Gornek in the Den, to the west.
rows.quest:4641:completion:0: Another one of Kaltunk's recruits, hm?
rows.quest:4641:completion:1: BA sorry state of affairs we find ourselves in if this is the best the ⟦E1⟧ can produce. No matter. By the time we think you're ready to leave the Valley, you'll be a proud ⟦19⟧ of the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5441:obj:0: Use the ⟦E5⟧'s Blackjack on Lazy Peons when they're sleeping. Wake up 5 peons, then return the ⟦E5⟧'s Blackjack to ⟦E5⟧ Thazz'ril in the Valley of Trials.
rows.quest:5441:details:0: Cursed peons! They work hard gathering lumber from the trees of the valley, but they're always taking naps! I need someone to help keep the peons in line.
rows.quest:5441:details:1: BYou look like the right ⟦20⟧ for my task. Here, you take this blackjack and use it on any lazy peons you find sleeping on the job. A good smack will get them right back to work! Return the blackjack when you're done.
rows.quest:5441:completion:0: Good, good. Maybe they'll think twice before slacking next time! Thanks for the help!
rows.quest:5843:obj:0: Bring the Valley of Trials Gift Voucher to Magga.
rows.quest:5843:details:0: Welcome to the World of Warcraft!
rows.quest:5843:details:1: BAs special thanks for purchasing the World of Warcraft Collector's Edition, turn in this gift voucher to Magga in the Valley of Trials. You'll then be given a gift: a little companion to join you on your quest for adventure and glory.
rows.quest:5843:details:2: BThanks again, and enjoy your stay in the World of Warcraft!
rows.quest:5843:completion:0: You are indeed a special hero, ⟦21⟧. We welcome you to the world of ⟦E6⟧, and offer you one of these unique gifts!
rows.quest:6394:details:0: ⟦22⟧, you are a dependable ⟦23⟧. Can I count on you for another task?
rows.quest:6394:details:1: BSome time ago I was surveying the cave to the north for minerals, and I left my favorite pick behind. When I later returned to retrieve it I found the cave was filled with vicious beasts! Will you go into the cave, the Burning Blade Coven, and get my pick?
rows.quest:6394:details:2: BI left it in a chamber with waterfalls. My pick has a spell on it so you can see it in the dark, so you won't have to worry about finding it... just what's guarding it!
rows.quest:6394:completion:0: Great, you got it! Thanks a lot, ⟦24⟧. This is my favorite pick! Now if my peons ever finish chopping down these trees, maybe we can find a nice cave to mine!
